Include many irregular ice cubes, with several protruding above the rim and a few sharp transparent chunks scattered at the bottom foreground. Use a dark black-to-deep-green studio background with emerald glow behind the drink, high-speed flash lighting, crisp specular highlights, shallow depth of field, wet reflective surface, extreme close-up perspective, commercial soda photography, ultra-detailed condensation, effervescent bubbles, refreshing cold atmosphere.
